notes: DISCOVERED during the wholesale-trade-2026-11-09 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). The channel is schedule risk, not data. Seven Census release calendars (calendar-listview-2020…2026.html, parsed row-wise this session) contain exactly three series that ever carry a `Suspended` row: the Advance Economic Indicators Report (5 reference months), Preliminary U.S. Imports for Consumption of Steel Products, and THIS one — the Advance Services Report, Third Quarter 2025, whose A202511201000 slot reads `Suspended`. That three-series list is the entire evidence base for the rule the proposing ledger and two of its siblings independently arrived at: Census cancels previews and keeps full reports. 2026-11-19 is the first Q3 edition scheduled after the only Q3 this series has lost, so whether it prints is the cleanest live test of that rule available in 2026, and it sits ten days after the proposing print. The calendar's Q3-2026 row carries reference code A202603 where a Q3 marker belongs — a Census data-entry oddity noted, not corrected here.
